queries.question: Quais são os 10 procedimentos mais comuns nas cidades do RS?

queries.question: Qual a evolução anual da taxa de mortalidade por estado (MA e RS)?
queries.gold_sql: SELECT mu.estado, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i."DT_INTER") AS ano, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes, SUM(CASE WHEN i."MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_mortes, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN i."MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS taxa_mortalidade FROM internacoes i JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu.codigo_6d WHERE mu.estado IN ('MA', 'RS') AND i."DT_INTER" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY mu.estado, ano ORDER BY mu.estado, ano;

queries.question: Qual o hospital com maior receita total por especialidade médica, considerando apenas hospitais com mais de 500 internações na especialidade?
queries.gold_sql: SELECT especialidade, "CNES", receita_total FROM (SELECT e."DESCRICAO" AS especialidade, i."CNES", ROUND(SUM(i."VAL_TOT"), 2) AS receita_total, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e."DESCRICAO" ORDER BY SUM(i."VAL_TOT") DESC) AS rn FROM internacoes i JOIN especialidade e ON i."ESPEC" = e."ESPEC" GROUP BY e."DESCRICAO", i."CNES" HAVING COUNT(*) > 500) sub WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY receita_total DESC;

queries.question: Quais são os 10 diagnósticos com maior crescimento absoluto de internações entre os períodos 2008-2012 e 2019-2023?
queries.gold_sql: WITH p1 AS (SELECT "DIAG_PRINC", COUNT(*) AS n1 FROM internacoes WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "DT_INTER") BETWEEN 2008 AND 2012 AND "DIAG_PRINC" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "DIAG_PRINC"), p2 AS (SELECT "DIAG_PRINC", COUNT(*) AS n2 FROM internacoes WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "DT_INTER") BETWEEN 2019 AND 2023 AND "DIAG_PRINC" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "DIAG_PRINC") SELECT c."CD_DESCRICAO", p1.n1 AS periodo_2008_2012, p2.n2 AS periodo_2019_2023, (p2.n2 - p1.n1) AS crescimento_absoluto FROM p1 JOIN p2 ON p1."DIAG_PRINC" = p2."DIAG_PRINC" JOIN cid c ON p1."DIAG_PRINC" = c."CID" WHERE p1.n1 > 1000 ORDER BY crescimento_absoluto DESC LIMIT 10;

queries.question: Qual o total e o percentual de internações por doenças respiratórias (CID J%) em cada trimestre do ano no estado do RS?
queries.gold_sql: SELECT t.trimestre, COUNT(*) AS total_respiratorio, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 2) AS pct_anual FROM internacoes i JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu.codigo_6d JOIN tempo t ON i."DT_INTER" = t.data WHERE i."DIAG_PRINC" LIKE 'J%' AND mu.estado = 'RS' GROUP BY t.trimestre ORDER BY t.trimestre;

queries.question: Qual a média móvel de 3 anos de internações no estado do RS por ano (2008-2023)?
queries.gold_sql: SELECT ano, total_internacoes, ROUND(AVG(total_internacoes) OVER (ORDER BY ano ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 0) AS media_movel_3anos FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i."DT_INTER") AS ano, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes FROM internacoes i JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu.codigo_6d WHERE mu.estado = 'RS' AND i."DT_INTER" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ano) sub ORDER BY ano;
queries.generated_sql: WITH anuais AS ( SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i."DT_INTER") AS ano, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes FROM internacoes i JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu."codigo_6d" WHERE i."DT_INTER" IS NOT NULL AND mu."estado" = 'RS' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i."DT_INTER") BETWEEN 2008 AND 2023 GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i."DT_INTER")) SELECT ano, total_internacoes, ROUND(AVG(total_internacoes) OVER (ORDER BY ano ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 0) AS media_movel_3anos FROM anuais ORDER BY ano;

queries.question: Quais códigos CID aparecem como causa de morte em óbitos registrados mas nunca foram registrados como diagnóstico principal de internação?
queries.gold_sql: SELECT c."CID", c."CD_DESCRICAO", COUNT(*) AS total_como_morte FROM internacoes i JOIN cid c ON i."CID_MORTE" = c."CID" WHERE i."MORTE" = true AND i."CID_MORTE" IS NOT NULL AND i."CID_MORTE" != '0' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM internacoes d WHERE d."DIAG_PRINC" = c."CID") GROUP BY c."CID", c."CD_DESCRICAO" ORDER BY total_como_morte DESC LIMIT 10;

queries.question: Quais são os 10 municípios do Maranhão com Bolsa Família acima da média estadual e mortalidade infantil abaixo da média estadual?
queries.gold_sql: WITH media_ma AS (SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN s.metrica = 'bolsa_familia_total' THEN s.valor END) AS avg_bf, AVG(CASE WHEN s.metrica = 'mortalidade_infantil_1ano' THEN s.valor END) AS avg_mi FROM socioeconomico s JOIN municipios mu ON s.codigo_6d = mu.codigo_6d WHERE mu.estado = 'MA'), por_municipio AS (SELECT mu.nome, MAX(CASE WHEN s.metrica = 'bolsa_familia_total' THEN s.valor END) AS bolsa_familia, MAX(CASE WHEN s.metrica = 'mortalidade_infantil_1ano' THEN s.valor END) AS mort_infantil FROM socioeconomico s JOIN municipios mu ON s.codigo_6d = mu.codigo_6d WHERE mu.estado = 'MA' GROUP BY mu.nome) SELECT pm.nome, pm.bolsa_familia, pm.mort_infantil FROM por_municipio pm, media_ma mm WHERE pm.bolsa_familia > mm.avg_bf AND pm.mort_infantil < mm.avg_mi AND pm.bolsa_familia IS NOT NULL AND pm.mort_infantil IS NOT NULL ORDER BY pm.bolsa_familia DESC LIMIT 10;
